(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, W=g.world, P=g.player; const out=[]; let tr=0, pulled=0, landed=0, close=0, sumIn=0, sumOut=0, maxCloser=0, swim=0, stuck=0; for (const id of ['landing','bend','falls','glacier','moose','pier']) { const pl=W.place(id); P.place(pl.x,pl.z,pl.face||0); const pts=__hookSpots(pl); let pTr=0, pPulled=0, pLanded=0, pClose=0, pIn=0, pOut=0, pCloser=0, pSwim=0, pStuck=0; __seeded(777, ()=>{ for (const q of pts) for (let k=0;k<3;k++) { const r=__fight(q,()=>false,600); pTr++; pIn+=r.inwardFree; pOut+=r.outward; pSwim+=r.swimSteps; pStuck+=r.stuckSteps; if (r.inwardFree>0.5) pPulled++; if (r.end.startsWith('landed')) pLanded++; if (r.min<3.2) pClose++; pCloser=Math.max(pCloser,r.start-r.min); } }); out.push(pl.name+': '+pTr+' fights from '+pts.length+' spots, pulled in without reeling in '+pPulled+', on average '+(pIn/Math.max(pTr,1)).toFixed(1)+' m a fight, at most '+pCloser.toFixed(1)+' m closer than where it bit, within 3.2 m in '+pClose+', landed without reeling '+pLanded+', line taken '+(pOut/Math.max(pTr,1)).toFixed(1)+' m a fight, unable to move '+(100*pStuck/Math.max(pSwim,1)).toFixed(0)+'% of its swimming time'); tr+=pTr; pulled+=pPulled; landed+=pLanded; close+=pClose; sumIn+=pIn; sumOut+=pOut; swim+=pSwim; stuck+=pStuck; maxCloser=Math.max(maxCloser,pCloser); } out.unshift('NOBODY REELS, 60 s a fight: '+tr+' fights, pulled in without reeling in '+pulled+', on average '+(sumIn/Math.max(tr,1)).toFixed(1)+' m a fight, at most '+maxCloser.toFixed(1)+' m closer than where it bit, landed without reeling '+landed+', line taken '+(sumOut/Math.max(tr,1)).toFixed(1)+' m a fight, unable to move '+(100*stuck/Math.max(swim,1)).toFixed(0)+'% of its swimming time'); return out.join('\n'); })()
